title: Full production three-component gradient-flow well-posedness
statement: For the canonical P1 variational functional on a fixed three-torus at the pinned production parameters and eta_shell=0, the full linear operator on the real Hilbert space L2(T3;C3) is self-adjoint on H4, bounded below by the positive shell mass, and coercive in H2. The family and lock matrices are positive semidefinite, the Class-II J-K coefficient matrix is positive definite, and the positive sextic term absorbs the negative quartic term. In six real coordinates the full Class-II Euler-Lagrange map has only second spatial order and the full lower-order map is locally Lipschitz H2 to L2. The canonical flow has a unique global H2 solution, continuous H2 dependence on finite intervals, the exact L2 gradient-flow energy identity, and C-infinity smoothing for every positive time. This is a complete T4 proof package in the pinned scope, not an automatic theorem-tier promotion.
scope: T4 FULL-PROOF-CANDIDATE: Psi in C3 on the fixed periodic cell; real L2 pairing; the hash-pinned A1 reference functional; production coefficients including positive rho and Class-II mass regularisers; eta_shell exactly zero. The theorem target is unique global H2 solutions, continuous H2 dependence, energy decrease, and C-infinity smoothing for t>0. The historical external backend and nonzero shell-bias continuum limits are excluded.
falsifier: A non-Hermitian production linear term, nonpositive linear H2 lower bound, indefinite Class-II coefficient matrix, loss of the positive regulariser or sextic coefficient, an error in the six-real-coordinate Euler-Lagrange expansion or its H2-to-L2 local-Lipschitz estimate, a failed projected Galerkin chain rule or H2/H4 compactness passage, failure of the exact energy identity/continuation argument, failure of the endpoint H4 Duhamel cancellation or higher Sobolev bootstrap, or a finite-time blow-up/non-uniqueness/discontinuous-dependence example in the stated H2 scope.
no_overclaim: T4 is a proof candidate, not a T6 theorem. No claim is made for the historical non-variational backend, eta_shell nonzero, Hs initial data below H2, R3/infinite volume, the mu2<0 branch, minimizer uniqueness, BCC selection, stability, T6, or T7.
